rule: For each possible edit at time t, compare frame-change metrics at t-.4→t-.2, t-.2→t, and t→t+.2. Call the central change an isolated spike only when both gray and histogram ratios to the larger flank are >=2. No event or cut labels enter this source-only calculation.
provenance: Thresholds chosen after selected China/Swiss development inspection; Norway/Slovakia plans frozen before their full possible-edit and isolation scans.
